Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Jabba's Influence]]: Marlon Brando as Don Vito Corleone, the Godfather, who says "I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse" in ''The Godfather'' (1972). A publicity photograph from NBC Television's promotion of the 45th Academy Awards (1973).
